name: formal-verification
description: Formal verification for the part of a codebase where a bug costs most. /formal-verification:chart model-checks a TLA+ spec with TLC and draws its states as a Mermaid chart, with the shortest path to each broken rule for a person to judge. /formal-verification:setup checks the toolchain and installs the pinned, checksummed model checker only on a typed yes. A consumer's formal-<area> skill follows reference/formal-skill.md; /formal-verification:specify proposes, writes and checks them.

model_checker_jar.title: Model checker jar
model_checker_jar.description: Path to tla2tools.jar, the TLC model checker. Unset uses the jar that setup installs under the plugin data directory.

java.title: Java binary
java.description: Path to the java binary that runs TLC. Unset uses java on PATH. The plugin never installs Java.

script_runtime.title: Script runtime
script_runtime.description: Path to the Node, Bun or Deno binary that runs the chart scripts. Unset lets the launcher pick the first supported one on PATH.
